title: Geometric finite restriction comparisons
statement: Fix $\ell$, $\Omega$, schemes and maps $f:X\to Y$, $y:s\to Y$, and an integral finite restriction diagram [def-zl-finite-restriction-integral-diagram]. Let $S=X\times_Ys$, $v,h$ its projections, $P_y$ its lift points and $i_x:s\to S$ their canonical lifts [lem-zl-finite-counit-restriction-towers]. A pullback comparison consists of constructible preservation for the actual completed integral pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], its scalar isomorphisms, and a morphism of the recorded raw rational stage systems [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Normalization means its integral comparison is exactly the completed tensor/pullback comparison [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], and rational objects, pure-tensor Hom maps and comparison components are the literal localizations. A geometric comparison family retains the strict integral and raw rational direct-image comparisons for $f,h$ [lem-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-comparison] and these pullback comparisons for $y,v,h,x,i_x$. Its normalization requires all the recorded integral and rational direct-image laws and all pullback normalizations. Endpoints identify the source and middle of the integral diagram with these geometric composites and identify its target as the limiting fan of the $x$-pullbacks, with natural projections; the empty fan is required to be zero.
